about: Each dealer's named trees (Jakob 2026-11-21: several trees per dealer, each with a name, about three at most; everything else is loose material that can later be deleted). A tree is a set of anchors from data/media-roles.json, by entry id: the root (A1) and the anchors it branches into, written in his notation by tools/dealer-tree.ts from the graph's nodes (IDLE = A1, READY = A2.1, READY-B = A2.2, READY-C = A2.3, a card node such as P4.C1 = A3P4C1). Films are not listed here: the tool finds every film whose first and last pictures are the tree's anchors. state: spelas (the game plays it), byggs (being made), vilar (resting). name is what Jakob sees and his to change. One set of hands is one tree, and one A1 may branch to several anchors at the shoe (Jakob 2026-11-26: "det enda som skiljer är väl bara att A1 kan förgrena sig till A2.1 eller A2.3"): the tree's own anchors are its first way of dealing, what the game plays when the tree is played; ways lists its further ways, each with its own anchors at the shoe of one node, and its own id, name and state, which the game (?trad=<id>), the compositions and Bordet take as a tree's. A film placed in the tree goes to the way whose anchor at the shoe it stands on; a film on none of them (rest, talk, the hole card) is the tree's and every way's. opening: a media-roles film outside the bank that leads into the root (the film before the game, /trailer). An anchor may carry seat (1-7) when its picture is seen from that seat instead of the straight camera; the tool then writes S2-A2.2. seat is set only where a register says the angle. The straight camera is seat 4's: the tree's nodes, its 36 steps, its number and what the game plays are that camera's, and an anchor with another seat, with the films that stand on it, is the same tree from that seat's camera (Karta's camera strip, ?kamera=2), never played as a straight film. markOf: the anchor is the same picture as the one named, with only the card's mark in the shoe's window changed (Jakob 2026-11-26): the same node, so the films on the one are never older for the other, and Karta shows the one that holds in Material. A tree is measured against his measure (src/dealer-trees.ts, 'en giv per kort'): 36 steps from its first A2.x anchor, the anchor at the shoe; its other A2.x anchors of its own stand in for it where the game plays their film. The first anchor given for a node is the node's picture. Read by tools/dealer-tree.ts, which writes its report to .runtime/dealer-trad/ and serves GET /api/trees to Karta. shares (a tree that plays another's anchors and films) is still read but no tree uses it. The tree Casino (the older, untattooed hands) was removed with its films on Jakob's word 2026-11-26.
